card.text: WASP-62 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-62"
sources.quote: It is an F-class main-sequence star, orbited by a planet, WASP-62b.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-62. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: The age of WASP-62 is much younger than the Sun at 0.8±0.6 billion years, and it has a metal abundance similar to the Sun.
